# Contract: brand-kit

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: design. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Extract a site's visual language into a reusable kit, check it visually, and prefer official guidelines.

## Use it for
- "learn this brand from its site"
- "match their brand for a sponsored video"

## Not for
- redistribute their fonts or logos (refused)

## Accepted inputs
Brand site URLs (or a local page).

## Deliverables
brand.json, board.png, local copies of assets for private use.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- Python 3.9+
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Opens the brand's pages and downloads their font and logo files into the private data folder.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Extract
2. Propose:
3. Board:
4. Check official guidelines

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Fix accent, fields, display font and image style by eye
- Check official guidelines

## Quality checks
- Board inspected next to the site

## Common failures
- Sites with system fonts only

## Limitations
- Extraction is not permission

## Reproducible example
A made-up brand page served locally (evidence/brand-kit).
